templates.description: Order totals joined to customer names
templates.sql: SELECT o.id, c.display_name, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.id

templates.description: Revenue per order from item detail
templates.sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id

templates.description: Report that intentionally depends on the retired legacy code
templates.sql: SELECT id, legacy_code FROM customers ORDER BY id
SELECT order_id, display_name, total_amount FROM v_order_totals ORDER BY order_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers
SELECT total_amount FROM orders WHERE id = 1
SELECT total_amount FROM orders WHERE id = 2
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total FROM orders
SELECT CAST(o.total_amount AS REAL) AS normalized_total FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.id

templates.description: Query cache depends on the total index
templates.sql: SELECT id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 1 ORDER BY total_amount

templates.description: Query cache depends on the status index
templates.sql: SELECT id, status FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' ORDER BY id
